description: M.A. Mary Margrate v. The Chairman, Road Development Authority and Others M.A. Mary Margrate v. The Chairman, Road Development Authority and Others View More before Hon. Sisira de Abrew, J.
parties: M.A. Mary Margrate v. The Chairman, Road Development Authority and Others M.A. Mary Margrate v. The Chairman, Road Development Authority and Others View More
keywords: The Appellant sought the intervention of this Court to set aside the High Court’s demolition order. Held - the building was unlawfully constructed within the prohibited road limit under Section 24 of the Thoroughfares Ordinance; arguments on partial demolition, survey plans, and local authority approval rejected in terms of Sections 26 and 24; Appeals against High Court decisions can only be heard by the Supreme Court. Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
